title: Qualifications.
officialText:
Applicants for an oil-burning equipment installer license shall submit satisfactory proof establishing that the applicant has had at least four (4) years of practical experience, within the seven (7) years prior to application, in the installation of oil-burning equipment under the direct and continuing supervision of a licensed oil-burning equipment installer in the city.

(Am. L.L. 2021/126, 11/7/2021, eff. 11/7/2022)
